newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds mixed in quiet trading.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds mixed in quiet trading.

text.p: UK meals and feeds prices were mixed on Tuesday, but buyers were still showing little interest.
"We have had the odd enquiry but nothing has come of them," said one broker.
High protein soymeal ex-mill and ex-store was one to two stg up in the nearby positions while forwards were one stg lower.
Rapemeal from the Erith mill was two to three stg lower while Liverpool and Hull plants were unchanged.
Corn gluten feed pellets and sunflower meal sellers were unchanged.
